svg.title: NeuroMesh commit pipeline
svg.desc: Six-stage horizontal pipeline with measured latency under each stage. Text in, zod validated, not benchmarked. Embed on the ONNX runtime at 384 or 768 dimensions, 2.85 or 6.79 milliseconds p50. Envelope encrypt with HKDF-SHA256 and AES-256-GCM, 0.027 milliseconds p50. IPFS pin via Pinata returning a CID, 2.73 seconds median. EIP-712 sign under the NeuroMeshMemoryLedger domain, not benchmarked. On-chain commit to Sepolia MemoryLedger, 16.2 seconds median. Footnotes state the methodology and mark the two network stages as coming from a five-run simulation rather than the local benchmark harness.

svg.text: p50 of local runs on Node v22.13.1 / win32: embed n=40 per model, encrypt n=200. Cold model load is excluded and reported separately (MiniLM 197 ms, distilRoBERTa 666 ms). CPU model not recorded.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: * network stages are NOT from the local bench harness. They are medians of n=5 Sepolia commits in simulation-results.json: IPFS pin 2.72–2.86 s, chain inclusion 7.0–21.3 s. Highly variable.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: Not shown: JL projection 768→384 at 0.20 ms p50; cosine similarity over 384d below timer resolution (n=5000).

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: Stages 1 and 5 have no separate instrumentation, so no latency is claimed for them.
